The inner ring, corresponding to Ambiguity 2, shows a red "Deceived" segment at 31.6%, a yellow "Partially" segment at 23.5%, and a green "Not Deceived" segment at 8.8%. The chart includes a legend for each ambiguity level, associating the colors red, yellow, and green with the respective deception outcomes. The percentages are explicitly labeled within each segment of the donut chart.
